notes.title: 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where the map display would not disappear when opening and closing the menu while the map was shown.
・Fixed an issue where certain effects would repeat under specific conditions.
・Fixed an issue where the true ending could be reached without meeting the required conditions.
・Implemented measures to prevent clipping through walls in certain rooms.
・Adjusted the interaction range for entering vehicles to make it more accessible.

notes.title: 1.08 Update
notes.content:
・Added an anomaly to the Time Attack mode (1 type)
・Review of collision detection

notes.title: 1.07 Update
notes.content:
・Changes to the end credits
・Other minor adjustments

notes.title: 1.06 Update
notes.content: ・Fixed an issue where entering a vehicle while standing on top of it would cause the vehicle to fly away, similar to the Ford Anglia in Harry Potter.

notes.title: 1.05 Update
notes.content: ・Fixed an issue where players could get stuck when moving to specific locations during the occurrence of certain anomalies.

notes.title: 1.04 Update
notes.content: ・Fixed an issue where some random events became fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
・Addition of Windowed Mode, Windowed Fullscreen, and Fullscreen Mode
・Adjustments to footsteps, sound effects, etc.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
・Request the senpai to raise their voice volume 
(optimize the senpai's voice volume/adjust other various sound levels).
・Adjust the default value and upper limit for camera controls.
・Modify the starting speed of dialogue.
・Add operation explanations for the gamepad (regarding RT/LT buttons).
・Other minor adjustments.

notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where the volume slider position on the opening screen would reset.
・Fixed an issue where the game would freeze midway through the ending sequence in certain environments.
・Fixed an issue where the number of talismans placed on anomalies exceeded the total possible amount.

notes.title: Himei Dam Ranking Event Announced! 🎮✨
notes.content:
To celebrate the release of "Himei Dam," we’re hosting a Time Attack Mode Ranking Event! 🎉

[Event Period]
December 6 (Friday) to December 15 (Sunday) until 11:59:59 PM(JST)

[Details]
Strange phenomena are occurring all over Himei Dam!
You must place the protective seals as quickly as possible!

Participate in the ranking event and compete with players nationwide for the fastest clear time!
Top players will have the chance to win amazing prizes!

[Prizes]
Top 5 players will receive:

A choice of one Actor game (Mannequin Mansion, Whispering Forest, Seven Nights Shrine, or Maze Shopping Street)
A ¥2,500 Steam gift card
Additionally, the top-ranking player might see their name featured in a future game!

[Eligibility]
Anyone who has purchased Himei Dam.

[Entry Fee]
Free

[Schedule]

December 6 (Fri): Himei Dam release
December 15 (Sun) 11:59:59 PM: Rankings finalized
From December 16 (Mon):

Actor will send a friend request on Steam to the top 5 players.
To facilitate prize delivery, please accept the friend request.
Prizes will be delivered via message.

[Important Notes]

Event details and schedule are subject to change without prior notice.
Prize-eligible games: For games not yet released (Mannequin Mansion, Whispering Forest), prizes will be delivered upon completion.
Rankings will be determined based on results from the Steam leaderboard.
Scores achieved through bug exploitation or other unfair methods will be invalidated.
Discrepancies in ranking display: If there is a mismatch between in-game rankings and the Steam leaderboard, we will respond flexibly to ensure fairness.
Prize delivery: If we are unable to contact a winner, we will be unable to deliver the prize.
This is our first time hosting such an event, so there may be some hiccups along the way. We hope everyone enjoys it! 😊

Thank you for your participation!!!
